'''{{ill|Ibukidonushi no Kami|ja|気吹戸主神|qid=Q86734190}}''' (気吹戸主神) is a deity appearing in {{ill|Japanese mythology|ar|أساطير يابانية|ast|Mitoloxía xaponesa|az|Yapon mifologiyası|bjn|Mitologi Japang|ca|Mitologia japonesa|cs|Japonská mytologie|de|Japanische Mythologie|el|Ιαπωνική μυθολογία|eo|Japana mitologio|es|Mitología japonesa|eu|Japoniar mitologia|fa|اسطوره‌شناسی ژاپنی|fi|Japanilainen mytologia|fr|Mythologie japonaise|he|מיתולוגיה יפנית|hi|जापानी पौराणिक कथाओं|hr|Japanska mitologija|hu|Japán mitológia|hy|Ճապոնական դիցաբանություն|ia|Mythologia japonese|id|Mitologi Jepang|it|Mitologia giapponese|ja|日本神話|jv|Mitologi Jepang|ka|იაპონური მითოლოგია|ko|일본 신화|la|Mythologia Iaponiae|lt|Japonų mitologija|min|Mitologi Japang|mk|Јапонска митологија|ms|Mitologi Jepun|my|ဂျပန်ဒဏ္ဍာရီ|nl|Japanse mythologie|no|Japansk mytologi|or|ଜାପାନୀ ଧର୍ମକଥା|pl|Mitologia japońska|pt|Mitologia japonesa|ro|Mitologia japoneză|ru|Японская мифология|sh|Japanska mitologija|simple|Japanese mythology|sk|Japonská mytológia|sr|Japanska mitologija|sv|Japansk mytologi|szy|nu Lipun a micidekay a kungku|tl|Mitolohiyang Hapones|tr|Japon mitolojisi|uk|Японська міфологія|uz|Yapon mifologiyasi|vi|Thần thoại Nhật Bản|zh|日本神話|qid=Q814158|lt=Japanese mythology}}. This deity is also mentioned in the {{ill|Ōharae no Kotoba|ja|大祓詞|simple|Ōharae no Kotoba|zh|大祓詞|qid=Q11438317|lt=Ōharae Kotoba}}, where they are described as a god who creates strong winds over the seas to blow away sins and impurities<ref name="T">{{Cite book|和書|author=E. Mogi & M. Sonoda|title=Encyclopedia of Japanese Gods|publisher=Gakken|page=47}}</ref>. The name is also written as Ibukidonushi no Kami.

== Overview ==
Ibukidonushi no Kami is one of the {{ill|Haraedo no Kami|ja|祓戸大神|zh|祓戶大神|qid=Q11588504}}. Many traditions equate this deity with {{ill|Kamuna'obi|ja|神直日神|qid=Q86725467}} and {{ill|Ōnaobi no Kami|ja|大直日神}}. According to the {{ill|Ōharae no Kotoba Goshaku|ja|大祓詞後釈|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135579168}}, it is said: 
*"This god, being the spirit that rectifies and purifies all evils, encompasses everything from the beginning to the end of driving away and losing all impurities, starting from the rapids of the swift river down to the root country."*

== Analysis ==
* In the {{ill|Yamatohime no Mikoto Seiki|ja|倭姫命世記}}, Ibukidonushi is identified as another name for Kamunaobi no Kami and Ōnaobi no Kami.
* The {{ill|Nakatomi Harai Kunkai|ja|中臣祓訓解|qid=Q140445966}}, traditionally attributed to {{ill|Kūkai|ar|كوكاي|arz|كوكاى|az|Kukay|ban|Kūkai|be|Кукай|ca|Kūkai|cs|Kúkai|cy|Kūkai|de|Kūkai|eo|Kūkai|es|Kūkai|eu|Kūkai|fa|کوکای|fr|Kūkai|frp|Kūkai|gl|Kūkai|hr|Koukai|hu|Kúkai|id|Kūkai|it|Kūkai|ja|空海|ko|구카이|lt|Kūkajis|mg|Kūkai|nl|Kūkai|no|Kūkai|pl|Kūkai|pt|Kukai|ro|Kūkai|ru|Кукай|sh|Kūkai|sk|Kúkai|sl|Kukai|sr|Кукај|sv|Kūkai|tr|Kūkai|uk|Кукай|vi|Không Hải|war|Kūkai|wuu|空海|zh|空海|zh_yue|空海|qid=Q222227}}, states: 
''' "This deity is named Kamunaobi no Kami and Ōnaobi no Kami, a god who hears and sees to correct matters."
* {{ill|Motoori Norinaga|ar|موتوري نوريناغا|bg|Мотоори Норинага|de|Motoori Norinaga|es|Motoori Norinaga|fa|موتوئوری نوریناگا|fi|Motoori Norinaga|fr|Motoori Norinaga|gl|Motoori Norinaga|hu|Motoori Norinaga|it|Motoori Norinaga|ja|本居宣長|ka|მოტოორი ნორინაგა|ko|모토오리 노리나가|lt|Norinaga Motoori|mt|Motoori Norinaga|pl|Norinaga Motoori|pt|Motoori Norinaga|ro|Motoori Norinaga|ru|Мотоори Норинага|simple|Motoori Norinaga|sl|Motoori Norinaga|th|โมโตริ โนรินางะ|uk|Мотоорі Норінаґа|zh|本居宣長|qid=Q384647|lt=Motoori Norinaga}}, a scholar of {{ill|Kokugaku|en|Kokugaku|qid=Q855159|lt=Kokugaku}}, offered a unique interpretation, equating {{ill|Seoritsu-hime|ja|瀬織津姫}} and {{ill|Magatsuhi-no-kami|ja|禍津日神|lt=Magatsuhi no Kami}} as the same deity. Following this logic, he interpreted Ibukidonushi no Kami as identical to Kamunaobi no Kami and Ōnaobi no Kami.
